note: Which works the roadmaps cite and whether a reader can get them. `access` is `free` when anyone can read the work without paying: arXiv, an author's page, an open archive. `substitute` names a free work that covers the cited material, and is filled only where the free source really does cover it. A work with `access: restricted` and no substitute is one somebody has to buy or borrow. Written and checked by scripts/sources.py.
